correctness.rationale: Exact Fourier coefficient identity partitions endpoints correctly. The 2x2 transfer matrix has only torus peripheral points (1,1) and (-1,-1), their dominant projections yield weight 3/8 each, positive covariance Hessian has determinant 1/16, and the Gaussian integral gives 3/(4πn). Finite literal census matches independent run-composition enumeration for n=2..17; mass checks through n=800; these checks are not substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: Collision probability is the order-two Rényi mass and expected ambiguity of the shortest nontrivial adjacent-read fingerprint. Its sharp c/n law contrasts with Θ(n²) possible profiles and quantifies substantial nonuniformity not resolved by profile counts, giving an informative structural invariant with a nontrivial leading constant.
